note: Fallback scenes play when travel progress and the story disagree: the tank is empty or the vehicle is gone. They use the same option format as the main scenarios, plus their own decision attributes.

scenes.title: Running on Fumes
scenes.text: The engine coughs and dies on the shoulder. The needle sits on E. The next town is somewhere ahead in the snow, and the light is going.

options.text: Siphon gas from the abandoned cars along the shoulder
options.note: Slow, cold work, but most stalled cars still have a gallon or two.

options.text: Walk to the next exit with the gas can
options.note: The station is looted, but the tanks underground still pump by hand. Hours on foot in the open.

options.text: Flag down the next set of headlights and offer food for fuel
options.note: A family shares five gallons, but you stood close to strangers.

options.text: Lock the doors and wait for a patrol to come by
options.note: No patrol comes. You lose half a day and you're still empty.

scenes.title: On Foot
scenes.text: You have no vehicle, and the next stop is still far down the highway. Walking the whole way would take days you don't have.

options.text: Search the motel lot for a car with keys in it
options.note: A pickup with a quarter tank and keys behind the visor.

options.text: Hitch a ride with a convoy of survivors
options.note: They take you as far as the next stop, but you ride packed in a truck bed.

options.text: Break into the dealership and hotwire something
options.note: It works, but the alarm brings the infected out of the service bays.

options.text: Start walking and hope something turns up
options.note: Nothing turns up. You walk for hours in the cold and get almost nowhere.
